name: Promo Code: Add thousands of promo codes to your site
author: lespinsdessables

sections.description:
Code Promo Sync for Codereduction is a 100% free WordPress plugin that allows:
– Automatically import and sync promo codes and brands via an external API.
– Create and manage custom taxonomies to organize brands.
– Display advanced searches for brands and promo codes using shortcodes.
– Customize SEO metadata for brand and promo code category pages.

Key features:

  1. Automatic synchronization of brand data and promo codes via API.
  2. Creation of taxonomies and custom post types for brands and categories.
  3. Integration of shortcodes to display searches and results on your pages or articles.
  4. Custom management of SEO titles and descriptions for brands and categories.
  5. Ease of use with an intuitive interface in the WordPress dashboard.

This plugin is ideal for sites that want to offer promo codes to their users and boost sales and engagements.

nb: Even if the plugin is translated into French and English, the imported promo codes are currently only in French

External services

This plugin connects to the codereduction.promo API to get promo codes and information about associated brands.

The username and password accesses generated on codereduction.promo are transmitted each time the content is synchronized, and each time a user clicks on a button to see a code.
This service is provided by “codereduction.promo”: CGU, privacy policy.

License

This plugin is distributed under the GPLv2 license or any later version.
sections.installation:
1. Download the plugin ZIP file.
  2. Go to the WordPress dashboard: Plugins > Add New.
  3. Click on Upload a plugin and select the ZIP file.
  4. Click on Install Now and then Activate the plugin.
  5. Create an API access in the Instructions menu.
  6. Configure the settings via the Configuration menu.
sections.faq:
Does this plugin require any special configuration?

Yes, you must enter your API credentials in the plugin settings to enable synchronization.

Can I customize the slugs of brands and categories?

Yes, slugs can be configured directly from the admin interface.

Can I customize the display of brands, promo codes and categories?

Yes, colors, backgrounds and various effects can be customized directly from the admin interface.
